_comment: Third-party + SimReady models replacing the procedural geometry in the industry scenes. See tools/assets/README.md. `pick` selects the candidate ingested into public/models/<slot>.glb; fetch.mjs fills title/author/license/url from the source metadata.

car_sedan.review: Same author as the hatch, SUV, box truck and pickups, so traffic reads as one family; b (Cadillac) works as a variant.

candidates.title: Light Box Truck - Low poly model
candidates.author: Daniel Zhabotinsky

box_truck.review: b is mis-oriented with extra geometry; c is a half model.

semi_tractor.review: Lighter and cleaner; b is more detailed but dark.

service_pickup.replaces: vehicles.tsx BucketTruck (field-service pickup with ladder + toolbox)

candidates.title: Generic 90s light pickup - Low poly model
candidates.author: Daniel Zhabotinsky

candidates.title: Generic Japan pickup - Low poly model
candidates.author: Daniel Zhabotinsky

service_pickup.review: Regular cab + long bed for the ladder rack; roll cage stripped, body mapped to the vehicle paint.

pickup_toolbox.review: Neither is a cross-bed truck box: the field-service pickup ships with its ladder rack only.

guardrail.review: W-beam rail with its curled terminal ends cropped so 3.64 m pieces run continuously; b is a crowd barrier.

candidates.title: Birch tree low poly handpainted (game ready)
candidates.author: Sergi Trojanski

tree.review: Reads as a tree when ghosted; soil disc stripped. Poly Haven trees (1-2M leaf-card triangles) dropped: they cannot reach the 6k budget.

combine.replaces: vehicles.tsx Combine (reel + unloading auger split as parts)
combine.review: Manufacturing-level detail (header, auger, cab). The pickup header has no separable reel, so it stays static; the unloading auger is modelled extended on the left.

tractor.review: c is a scan with ground; d is similar but darker.

candidates.notes: TurboSquid: no open model found; upload to tools/assets/incoming/upload/

grain_cart.review: No open model and no upload yet: upgraded hand-built cart (ribbed hopper, walking-beam tandem, folding auger).

grain_bin.review: Corrugated bin pair + elevator leg replaces the three procedural silos; b is the alternative single silo.

machine_shed.review: Concrete apron and ground plane stripped; turned square to the axes.

crop.replaces: Agriculture Crop cones (instanced; ~1,000 clumps at full detail)
crop.review: Single wheat clump decimated to 360 triangles for ~1,600 instances; a is a row strip that falls apart when decimated.

weather_station.replaces: Agriculture WeatherStation (anemometer cups split as a part)

candidates.title: Weather station
candidates.author: TRYFIELD
candidates.notes: Stevenson screen; pair with the weather vane (c) on a mast if no upload

weather_station.review: No open model reads as an agricultural station (a is broken, b a handheld meter, c a rooster vane): upgraded hand-built mast (vehicles-style palette) until a TurboSquid upload arrives.

wind_turbine.replaces: Energy WindTurbine (rotor split as a part)
wind_turbine.review: More geometry than a (2k triangles); rotor to be split as a part. b is broken.

solar_table.review: Real PV module pair laid flat (it ships tilted 42°), tiled along tilted rows on hand-built racking; a/b are carports, c is a miniature plant.

inverter.review: Inverters + disconnects on a unistrut frame, as in a field installation; a is an AC condenser.

breaker.review: This is a molded-case breaker, not substation switchgear: TurboSquid upload, or let the substation structure (substation_bay d) carry the HV equipment.

substation_bay.review: Open steel frame for the gantry + bus work.

control_house.review: Long substation building scaled to 3.3 m.

candidates.title: Classic Shipping Container (Free/Gameready)
candidates.author: Sebastian Webster
candidates.notes: Fallback until the TurboSquid upload: ISO container shell, door end cropped off (closed with a hand-built end wall + HVAC units), tinted white
TurboSquid; fallback is the shipping_container pick with HVAC units

bess.review: No TurboSquid upload yet: the classic ISO container shell with its door end cropped off and tinted white; the scene closes it with an end wall carrying the HVAC units.

candidates.title: New York City Subway car Type-R142
candidates.author: yarankepang

metro_car.review: R142; c (R62A) is an equally good alternative.

subway_tunnel.review: Bored tube segment (5.4 m), cropped to its back half for the cut-away and repeated along the line.

subway_station.review: Platform section with track; its end walls and back vault are cropped so sections join into one continuous station that is turned to run the track along the cut face.

subway_entrance.review: Ground signage slab and ticket terminal stripped; source scale kept with the street at y = 0 (its stairs descend 4.7 m, inside the earth block).

traffic_signal.replaces: Infrastructure TrafficSignal (lamps stay as live indicator overlays)
traffic_signal.review: One GE DR6 head kept (the others stripped), lenses split as red / amber / green parts the scene drives; mounted on the SimReady signal arm.

candidates.title: Low rise wall to wall office building
candidates.author: aitortilla01

candidates.title: Mid rise wall to wall office building
candidates.author: aitortilla01

candidates.title: Low rise wall to wall office building
candidates.author: aitortilla01

city_building.review: a, with c (city_store) and d (city_office) as the rest of the block (b is too narrow).

shipping_container.review: Single mesh with one door modelled ajar (matches the "doors open" status); body mapped to the light palette tone. Also re-tinted white for the BESS fallback.

dock_door.review: Neither open dock door fits; the SimReady entrance wall module (dock opening, shelter and leveller) is used for the dock bays.

warehouse_wall.review: a for plain bays (dock bays use dock_door c); scaled to the scene’s 6.5 m wall height.

stretch_wrapper.replaces: Facilities StretchWrapper (turntable + carriage split as parts)
stretch_wrapper.review: No open model and no upload yet: upgraded hand-built turntable wrapper (skirted turntable, mast, carriage with film roll and pre-stretch rollers, pendant, light curtain).

hospital_screen.replaces: Healthcare low partitions + X-ray control screen
hospital_screen.review: Replaces the low partitions and X-ray control screen.

queue_stanchion.review: Neither fits a restaurant queue: the queue rail is dropped.

food_warmer.review: Too crude: the SimReady pass counter is kept without the heat-lamp shelf.

walk_in_cooler.replaces: Retail WalkIn (door split as a part)
walk_in_cooler.review: No TurboSquid upload yet: a (two-door cold-storage unit) widened to the cooler footprint, doors split as parts.
